method: Two repetitions per point within one server lifecycle per arm; compiled without AR, decode_only, then compiled with AR on the same GPU pair. Warmup excluded. The final compiled_ar arm keeps manual AR/Norm enabled. Uniform token IDs, greedy, ignore_eos. TTFT is client-observed and includes scheduling; single-token empty-text completion timestamps use the finish event.
compiled_no_ar_note: The default arm was measured before compile-compatible manual AR/Norm was implemented; fusion was disabled by its compilation admission guard. Equivalent current switch: --no-fused-ar-norm.
